Delivery

We deliver across Pakistan. Orders arrive in 3–5 working days from the day we confirm them with you.

Delivery is Rs. 250 per order, and complimentary on orders of Rs. 10,000 or more.

Payment

We accept cash on delivery. When you place an order it is sent to us on WhatsApp, and we confirm the details with you before anything is dispatched. You pay the courier when your order arrives.

Exchanges

If the size is not right, tell us within 7 days of delivery and we will arrange an exchange.

  • Pieces must be unworn and unwashed, with their tags attached.
  • Pieces bought on sale can be exchanged for a different size only.
  • If your order arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us straight away and we will put it right.

Size guide

Our sizes are based on body measurements in inches. If you fall between two sizes, we suggest choosing the larger one.

Body measurements in inches
SizeBustWaistHip
XS322635
S342837
M363039
L393342
XL423645

How to measure

  • Bust: around the fullest part, keeping the tape level.
  • Waist: around the narrowest part of your waist.
  • Hip: around the fullest part, standing with your feet together.

Garment care

Each piece lists its own care instructions on its page. As a general guide:

  • Dry clean velvet, silk and embroidered pieces.
  • Hand wash cottons gently in cold water and dry them in the shade.
  • Store embroidered pieces folded flat, with tissue between the layers.
